title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. glomerulans
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. glomerulans, commonly known as the European lady's mantle, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include soothing and calming properties for the digestive system, as well as its anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to regulate bowel movements, reduce inflammation, and support the healing of wounds. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. glomerulans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
